raw.details:
Goblet of Codes – Competitive Programming Contest

Presented by KAUSHALYA 2.0 – Annual Tech & Cultural Fest
UTD, Chhattisgarh Swami Vivekanand Technical University, Bhilai

Get ready to put your coding skills to the ultimate test!

Goblet of Codes is an exciting Competitive Programming Contest organized as part of KAUSHALYA 2.0, the annual technical and cultural fest of UTD, CSVTU Bhilai.

This competition is designed for passionate programmers, problem solvers, and aspiring developers who love tackling challenging problems through logical thinking, algorithms, and efficient coding.

Whether you are a competitive programming enthusiast or someone looking to challenge your problem-solving abilities, this is your opportunity to compete, learn, and showcase your coding talent!

Event Details

  • Event Name: Goblet of Codes – Competitive Programming Contest
  • Fest: KAUSHALYA 2.0
  • Date: 27 November 2026
  • Time: 12:00 PM – 02:00 PM
  • Venue: Computing Labs, UTD, CSVTU Bhilai
  • Organized By: ACE Club, UTD CSVTU

Important Guidelines & Instructions

  • All participants must register for the competition on this page before the registration deadline.
  • Participants must report to the designated venue before the commencement of the competition.
  • Any further instructions regarding the contest will be shared with registered participants by the organizing team.
  • Participants must follow all contest rules and instructions provided by the organizing team.
  • Any form of plagiarism, code sharing, or unfair practices will result in disqualification.
  • The decision of the organizing committee will be final and binding.

  • Join Our WhatsApp Group

    Join the group for all contest updates: Goblet Of Codes

Ready to Claim the Goblet?

Sharpen your logic, optimize your algorithms, and prepare to compete against some of the brightest coding minds!

Think. Code. Compete. Conquer.

Let your code do the talking at GOBLET OF CODES – KAUSHALYA 2.0!

PPTS | UTD, CSVTU Bhilai
